source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API + raw WZ API; class-specific 5th job skill list cross-checked against maplestorywiki.net
notes: Single-file class (job 13500); no 5th-job V skills in scope.

skills.name: Yeti All Soft Now!
skills.description: A Yeti who drank the wrong potion and traded strength for cuteness.

skills.name: Rage Enhancement: Super Jetpack
skills.description: After a great deal of explosive research, Yeti has created the ultimate jetpack! Once learned, enables Homemade Super Jetpack while Enraged. Permanently increases Speed as a passive effect.

skills.name: Rage Enhancement: Yeti Smash
skills.description: Yeti's heightened rage enhances Yeti Smash, allowing for a more powerful 2nd Hit attack.

skills.name: Yeti Charisma
skills.description: Yeti, the most powerful creature in all of Maple World, possesses numerous abilities that make him totally different from normal monsters. At least that's what Yeti thinks.

skills.name: Yeti Power
skills.description: As Yeti starts to recover his lost powers,his stats will continue to increase.

skills.name: Snack Dash
skills.description:
Yeti lunges violently forward in pursuit of snacks, dealing damage to enemies in his path while moving forward in the direction of the arrow key pressed. Does not collide with enemies while moving forward.
Snack Dash can be used as an attack and can be eup to 3 times in a row.

skills.name: Snack Dash
skills.description:
Yeti lunges violently forward in pursuit of snacks, dealing damage to enemies in his path while moving forward in the direction of the arrow key pressed. Does not collide with enemies while moving forward.
Snack Dash can be used as an attack and can be eup to 3 times in a row.

skills.name: Snack Dash
skills.description:
Yeti lunges violently forward in pursuit of snacks, dealing damage to enemies in his path while moving forward in the direction of the arrow key pressed. Does not collide with enemies while moving forward.
Snack Dash can be used as an attack and can be eup to 3 times in a row.

skills.name: Yeti Flight
skills.description:
Pepe gives Yeti a boost, allowing him to double-jump in the desired direction.
When used while holding the up arrow key, Yeti performs a high jump that inflicts damage to nearby enemies upon landing.
Yeti Flight is unaffected by attack reflection.
Right-click to lock the command.

skills.name: Yeti Rage
skills.description:
Annoyed from constantly being attacked, Yeti accumulates rage. Upon use, Yeti becomes Enraged.\r
While Enraged, the skill Yeti Smash replaces Snack Dash.
While Enraged, the duration of Hey Pepe!, Yeti Master Chef, and Hero of El Nath will not decrease, but some skills will be unavailable for use.
Yeti Rage is not affected by cooldown resets or buff duration increases.

skills.name: Yeti Smash
skills.description: Enraged, Yeti uses his massive fists to demolish enemies in his path.

skills.name: Homemade Jetpack
skills.description:
Yeti zooms forward on his Homemade Jetpack.
It can be used in 8 directions and will move in the direction of the arrow keys pressed.
The Jetpack recharges periodically.

skills.name: Yeti Smarts: Book Toss
skills.description:
Having been disturbed while reading, Yeti retaliates by throwing his book at monsters in his path.
Yeti Smarts skills grant rage based on the number of enemies hit. Permanently increases Final Damage.

skills.name: Yeti Master Chef
skills.description:
Hungry, Yeti decides to cook a meal for the whole party. Increases Attack Power and EXP for you and nearby party members. This EXP buff is halved for characters on a different map than the caster.
Yeti Master Chef is unaffected by buff duration increases.

skills.name: Homemade Super Jetpack
skills.description:
Yeti moves even faster with Super Jetpack.
 It can be used in 8 directions and will move in the direction of the arrow keys pressed.
The Super Jetpack recharges periodically.

skills.name: Yeti Smarts: Bomb Disposal
skills.description:
Yeti does his very best to defuse a bomb, but it explodes anyway, dealing damage in a wide area.
Yeti Smarts skills grant rage based on the number of enemies hit. Permanently increases Final Damage.

skills.name: Homemade Snowman
skills.description:
Yeti tries to build a snowman, but what he creates is an abomination whose howls of pain periodically damage nearby enemies at set intervals.
Enemies hit by this attack will have their Speed reduced, and take increased damage from all sources. Yeti gains additional rage when defeating an afflicted enemy.
Homemade Snowman is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Hero of El Nath
skills.description:
Yeti, who dreams of becoming a great knight, rallies his friends, temporarily increasing the stats of him and his party members.
Stacks with Maple Warrior, Call of Cygnus, Nova Warrior, Hero of the Flora, President's Orders, Anima Warrior, Rhinne's Protection, and Pink Warrior.
Hero of El Nath is not affected by buff duration increases.

skills.name: Yeti Smash
skills.description: Furious, Yeti demolishes enemies in his path.

skills.name: Hey Pepe!
skills.description:
Yeti summons his old friend Pepe to aid him in battle.
When used, increases EXP for a set period of time. When attacking enemies, there is a chance of summoning Pepes, who attack the enemy and grant Yeti additional rage.
Hey Pepe! is not affected by buff duration increases or attack reflection.

skills.name: Yeti Smarts: Scientific Research
skills.description:
Yeti attempts to develop an upgrade to his jetpack, then boom! A chemical explosion deals damage to enemies in a wide area.
Yeti Smarts skills grant rage based on the number of enemies hit. Permanently increases Final Damage.
Yeti Smarts: Scientific Research is not affected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Spice Overload
skills.description:
Yeti spots a pot of fiery peppers and tries to eat them. Overwhelmed with spicy capsaicin, Yeti accumulates rage at an accelerated rate for a set period of time.
Spice Overload is not affected by cooldown resets or buff duration increases.

skills.name: Rage Enhancement: Explosive Fists
skills.description:
Yeti's heightened rage further enhances Yeti Smash.
Yeti Smash's 2nd hit now fires a shockwave forward, striking enemies in a wide area.
Rage Enhancement: Explosive Fists is not affected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Yeti Smarts: Violin Solo
skills.description:
The house lights fade, the spotlight is on Yeti. He begins to play, and SCREECH! His violin releases a shockwave that deals damge to enemies in a wide area.
Yeti Smarts skills grant rage based on the number of enemies hit. Permanently increases Final Damage. However, you can only obtain one rage per enemy struck using this skill.
Yeti Smarts: Violin Solo is not affected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Rage Enhancement: Furious Roar
skills.description:
Yeti focuses all his rage to devastate his surroundings.
Rage Enhancement: Furious Roar is not affected by attack reflection and can only be used once for the duration of the Enraged state.

skills.name: Spirit of El Nath
skills.description:
Summons the ancient Yeti Guardian that has been protecting the Yetis of the El Nath Mountains for generations. It seems the Yeti Guardian longed for Maple World's Goddess.
Unaffected by attack reflection.
